name: Fire protection and gas detection
description: Fire protection and gas detection Primary source: https://www.cummins.com/sites/default/files/2024-08/t035-Gas-Power-Plant-application-manual.pdf

specifications.basis: Cummins Gas Power Plant Application Manual, section 5.6.3 Fire Arrangements
specifications.value: design by competent licensed professional and reviewed by Cummins; uninterruptible emergency power for critical functions; smoke and heat detection in all non-sprinkled areas; alarms monitored 24/7 at constantly attended location

specifications.metric: Minimum fire rating of enclosure boundaries
specifications.unit: hour (walls, shutters, ceiling, doors and windows)
specifications.basis: Cummins Gas Power Plant Application Manual, section 5.6.3

specifications.metric: Fire Detection System in plant common systems
specifications.value: listed as a common power-plant system and classified 'Non Critical' in the Schneider/Wärtsilä study (gas piping/pressure reduction, gas storage, electrical distribution, control system classified Critical)

specifications.basis: Cummins Gas Power Plant Application Manual, section 3.3 ventilation/dampers
specifications.value: gravity-type dampers close on actuator failure or loss of AC power, starving enclosure of air and helping extinguish fire; dampers to be used with screen

notes: Merged from 1 page-read component studies in the 2026-11-24 gas-engine/data-centre sweep.
